text:
alice: Hey folks — starting staged rollout r5.12.1 to 10% (EU/US) now. Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Release notes: https://redwood.ai/releases/r5.12.1

deploy-bot: [DEPLOY] starting staged rollout r5.12.1 -> prod (10% traffic). Canary groups: eu-west-1a, us-east-1b. Rollout ID: ro-7012345678.

ben: Noted. Infra flagged one host in eu-west with disk pressure earlier but autoscaler healed.

carla: QA seeing intermittent 502s on the chat route in eu-west canary — mostly on long prompts. Snapshot id: 7012345678-qa-1

alice: @carla can you paste a sample log line / frequency?

carla: log excerpt: "upstream read timeout after 30s" — 3 events in last 10m, only for requests >8k tokens.

dmitri: I'm seeing p50 latency +20% on canary chat and a small increase in 5xx. KV-cache miss and retry patterns look suspicious.

ben: there was a KVCACHE OOM on one pod in eu-west-1a earlier, it restarted. Could be related to cache warming and retries.

alice: ok hold the ramp. Do NOT advance 10% -> 30%. Pin eu-west to r5.12.0 until we investigate.

deploy-bot: [ACTION] pausing rollout ro-7012345678. Traffic hold applied at 10%. Pinning route chat-prod -> r5.12.0 in eu-west. To resume: `/deploy resume ro-7012345678`

carla: can we run a targeted smoke for long prompts on the pinned hosts? want to reproduce.

dmitri: i'll run the same prompt set locally and in staging. if kv-cache is the culprit we'll bump kv-cache memory and re-run perf tests.

alice: if we need to rollback use:
```
/deploy rollback --id ro-7012345678 --to r5.12.0 --reason "canary 502s long-prompt"
```

ben: also adding temporary circuit-breaker on chat route for requests >10k tokens.

carla: QA will run 200 long-prompt tests in eu-west once dmitri gives the go.

dmitri: starting smoke now. first 50 tests -> 2 failures (timeout). collecting traces.

deploy-bot: [NOTIFY] ro-7012345678 paused by alice at 7012345686. Status: HALTED. Notifications sent to #eng-oncall.

alice: keep the hold for 30m. Dmitri share findings and we'll reconvene. If errors drop below 0.1% after config tweak we can consider resuming.

ben: logged incident note: https://redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-134

carla: QA also spotted rare response truncation on a small subset — tagging @alice @ben

dmitri: trace shows fallback to a slower kernel selection when seq >8k; quantization-compat path triggers fallback. fix is queued but not hotfix-ready.

alice: decision: maintain pause, pin eu-west to r5.12.0, notify customers in the change window. Prepare rollback if fix not available within 4h.

carla: ack :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: [LOG] ro-7012345678 state=PAUSED pinned_zones=[eu-west-1a] paused_by=alice

ben: opening PR with kv-cache bump + perf tests. @dmitri can you review?

dmitri: on it, aiming for PR by EOD.
